neighbours.label: ' Ne' as the first piece of a name (Ne|ve, Ne|umann, Ne|ft|ali), as opposed to names with similar openings that the tokenizer splits another way (N|esh|ama, Neu|haus, Nes|her, Na|ft|ali) and whole tokens (Neil)
